title: JoinME
description: This is a Velocity plugin that allows players to share their current server location with others.
body:
This is a Velocity plugin that allows players to share their current server location with others using a stylish, interactive chat message, including a live-rendered 8x8 pixel player head

**What's New in Version 1.0.0:**
- Fully customizable multi-line join messages with MiniMessage formatting
- 8x8 pixel player head rendered directly in chat (no external images)
- Clickable join button: players can join the sender's server with one click
- Two server lists: control where the command can be used and where notifications are sent
- Permission-based cooldowns: set different cooldowns for different groups (e.g. VIP, default)
- YAML configuration with live reload support via /joinmereload
- Version checker: /joinmeversion command checks for updates
- Full Adventure API and Velocity 3.3+ support

**Commands:**
- /joinme - Share your current server with others (with cooldown and permission support)
- /joinmeversion - Check plugin version and available updates
- /joinmereload - Reload the plugin configuration

**Permissions:**
- joinme.use - Allows using the /joinme command (or any permission listed in permission-cooldowns)
- joinme.reload - Allows reloading the plugin configuration
- joinme.vip, joinme.premium, joinme.default, etc. - Grant command access and set custom cooldowns

**How it works:**
- Players use /joinme to broadcast their current server to other players on configured servers.
- The message includes a live-rendered 8x8 pixel player head and up to 8 lines of customizable text.
- The join button is fully clickable and will run /server <server> for the recipient.
- Cooldowns and permissions are fully configurable for different player groups.

**Supported Velocity Versions:**
3.3.0, 3.4.0-SNAPSHOT and higher

For questions, suggestions, or support, contact me on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/vVrpvBEfeQ)!
